art.title: The Little Street
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons (Google Art Project)
art.story: An old brick house in Delft, its stepped gable against the clouds. A woman sews in the open door, a maid works at a tub at the end of the narrow alley, and two children kneel on the street, busy with some game. Every brick, every crack in the whitewash and every green shutter is there, but nothing much happens: this is simply an ordinary afternoon. Vermeer painted only two views of his town. In 2015 a historian worked out which house it was, from old records of the canal fees paid by each house.
